coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Per-Land open ALKIS WFS/OGC API; no single national service
coverageAssessment.twoRegionTestNote: Explicitly: Hessen (Frankfurt, Kassel) and Niedersachsen (Hannover, Oldenburg) are two verified sub-national services from different regions sharing the AdV ALKIS-vereinfacht "ave:Flurstueck" schema; so are Sachsen-Anhalt, Thueringen, MV, Sachsen. Every listed Land was itself sampled in two places. This does not make it a single national source: Bayern is credentialed (401) and Berlin was not reachable this pass.
